verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers transcription modes, vocabulary, polishing, authentication, batch jobs, and webhooks, but nothing on whether customer audio or transcripts are used for model training, or on any opt-out control. Training-data privacy is a fair question for an AI transcription API, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence yields "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
